howItWorks.metaDesc: How to use Notion Manual Maker. Complete from install to Notion save in 3 steps. Auto-create operation manuals with screenshots and arrows.
howItWorks.title: Create an Operation Manual in 3 Steps
howItWorks.sub: From install to Notion save in under 5 minutes

steps.title: Install, Sign In & Connect Notion
steps.desc: Add the extension from the Chrome Web Store. Sign in with Google, then link your Notion workspace.
detail: Search for "Notion Manual Maker" on the Chrome Web Store
Click "Add to Chrome"
Click the toolbar icon → "Sign in with Google"
Click "Connect" → log in to Notion
Authorize workspace access and you're done

steps.title: Click Through Your Screen
steps.desc: Press "Start Recording" to enter recording mode. Just click each part of the screen you want to document.
detail: Press "Start Recording" — the screen dims slightly
Click step ① location → screenshot + arrow auto-generated
Continue clicking steps ②③…
Press Esc or "Stop Recording" to finish

steps.title: Save to Notion
steps.desc: Add labels to each step and click "Save to Notion". Image blocks + text are automatically added to your chosen page.
detail: Enter labels in the step list in the popup (optional)
Enter a page title (auto-filled with date if omitted)
Click "Save to Notion"
Image + text blocks added to your Notion page

desktopApp.title: Document Any Windows App
desktopApp.sub: No Chrome needed. Works with Excel, PowerPoint, and any Windows application.

steps.title: Download & Install
steps.desc: Download the installer from the GitHub Releases page and run it.
detail: Download the latest .exe from GitHub Releases
Run the installer
The app icon appears in the system tray when ready

steps.title: Sign In & Connect Notion
steps.desc: Sign in with Google and connect your Notion workspace. Using the same account as the extension will sync your Notion connection automatically.
detail: Click "Sign in with Google"
Use the same account as the extension (recommended)
Notion connection syncs automatically — or click "Connect" to link manually
Authorize Notion workspace access

steps.title: Click Through Your Screen
steps.desc: Press "Start Recording", then click each part of any Windows app you want to document.
detail: Press the "Start Recording" button
Click through any Windows application
Press Esc or "Stop Recording" to finish

steps.title: Save to Notion
steps.desc: Save to Notion the same way as the extension. You can also generate AI captions.
detail: Optionally generate AI captions
Click "Save to Notion"
Image + text blocks added to your Notion page
